findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: route_task, check_tool_reliability, audit_server, watch_tool, get_notifications · Private data: check_tool_reliability, call_remote_tool, audit_server, select_tools, scan_tools, watch_tool, get_notifications, unwatch, create_key · Public sink: call_remote_tool, discover_tools, select_tools, scan_tools, watch_tool, get_notifications, report_outcome · Destructive: call_remote_tool, report_outcome.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: route_task, check_tool_reliability, audit_server, watch_tool, get_notifications · Private data: check_tool_reliability, call_remote_tool, audit_server, select_tools, scan_tools, watch_tool, get_notifications, unwatch, create_key · Public sink: call_remote_tool, discover_tools, select_tools, scan_tools, watch_tool, get_notifications, report_outcome · Destructive: call_remote_tool, report_outcome

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
